correctness.rationale: The explicit inward-ray matrix has determinant one and gives the correct smooth fan and Cox homogenizations. Its graph shows U_m=A2 and U_m^circ as the four-factor complement. The polynomial h_m has exactly r_m distinct roots by a Möbius transform of m-th roots of -1. Three affine lines and a punctured affine graph have exactly four transverse double intersections; compact-support Mayer–Vietoris plus Alexander duality give H1=Z4 and H2=Z^(4+r_m), without torsion. Generic log critical equations eliminate to degree r_m+1; discriminant and boundary-root checks yield exactly that many nondegenerate points. The embedded verifier confirms finite sanity instances, not universality.
